scientific_integrity: The original exact univariate counts and their leading asymptotic are attributed to OEIS A211422 and A120486. The claim is only the three-way joint limiting independence with explicit slope law and truncation estimate. Finite verifier is not a proof of the limit.
scientific_limitations: Only nonzero integral 2-by-2 square-zero matrices with uniform supremum-norm-box sampling; quantitative joint error for bounded slope intervals and content exponent below one. An unindexed general homogeneous-cone equidistribution theorem may imply the statement.
title: Independent content, height, and kernel-direction limits for integral square-zero matrices
